# office-open-day

Behavior contract:
is_open(day) accepts a datetime.date and returns True for Monday through Friday and False for Saturday or Sunday. Public holidays are outside this function. Do not read the system clock.

Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`.
Use only the Python 3.12 standard library. Keep the interface and leave tests/ unchanged.

turns.prompt:
office-open-day has a regression: is_open(date(2026, 5, 9)) should be False because it is Saturday, but it is currently True.
Read office_calendar.py, README.md and tests/, then repair office_calendar.py. Full contract: is_open(day) accepts a datetime.date and returns True for Monday through Friday and False for Saturday or Sunday. Public holidays are outside this function. Do not read the system clock.
Keep the interface and tests unchanged; install no dependencies. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` and report the cause and actual result.

turns.final: datetime.date.weekday() numbers Monday as zero and Saturday as five, so the open weekdays are zero through four. Ran `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests`; all tests passed.
